profile.name: Chandra Bhakta Adhikari
profile.title: Program Manager & Strategic Partnerships
profile.tagline: I build the room, then give it a reason to act.
profile.summary: Youth engagement and stakeholder-partnership professional with 5+ years building relationships with youth, colleges, NGOs and institutional partners across Nepal. Direct training and cultivation of 5,000+ youth across 10+ districts.
profile.bioLong: I build relationships that move people from first interest to real commitment. Five plus years bridging youth, colleges, NGOs, government and business across Nepal, leading participants through a full engagement funnel: outreach, motivation building, event conversion and follow through. That includes direct training and cultivation of 5,000+ youth across 10+ districts. I started in geology, mapping ground and reading rock, and that same habit of showing up in person carried straight into program management, stakeholder reporting and event delivery.

capabilities.note: Field mapping, ERT, SRT, spatial survey

projects.title: Nepal Business Summit
projects.dek: Ministries, sponsors, media and entrepreneurs. One stage, one week, and every logistics chain running through a single plan.
projects.body: The Nepal Business Summit and the Nepal Youth Entrepreneurship Summit don't happen because a venue is booked. They happen because a hundred separate agreements land on the same day. I own that chain: strategy, budget, sponsorship, government liaison, stall allocation, media, and the FAQ document that keeps three hundred exhibitors from calling the same number at once. Two years running the program office, now leading it outright.
highlights: Led planning and delivery for two flagship national summits
Grew sponsorship and strategic partnerships year over year
Built the stakeholder and vendor coordination system now used as the program template

projects.title: MHM & WASH, Village to Village
projects.role: Trainer & Consultant, Connection Nepal / Eco Connect
projects.dek: Reusable sanitary pads, disaster response, climate adaptation. Training built for classrooms with no electricity and a lot at stake.
projects.body: Some of these sessions happen twelve days at a stretch, in municipalities you won't find pinned on a tourist map: Baitadi, Rautahat, Sindhupalchok, Mahottari. Menstrual Hygiene Management, WASH-in-schools, and Disaster Risk Reduction training, built from manuals I write myself and teach myself, because the content only works if it survives contact with an actual classroom.
highlights: Designed and delivered training manuals still in active use across partner districts
Ran enterprise-development tracks turning MHM training into small local businesses
Coordinated disaster-response and climate-adaptation sessions alongside core MHM/WASH work

projects.title: District Secretary, Rotaract 3292
projects.role: Rotary International's youth service arm, Nepal & Bhutan
projects.dek: Six years climbing from Sergeant-at-Arms to running district administration for one of Rotary's largest youth networks.
projects.body: District Secretary is the job where nothing is glamorous and everything has to work: governance, communication, records, and the connective tissue between 150-plus clubs across Nepal and Bhutan. I got here by doing the smaller jobs first: club president, SAP coordinator, assistant district secretary. Every rung taught the one that came after it.
highlights: Administers district-wide communication and governance for 150+ Rotaract clubs
Progressed through five leadership roles over six consecutive years
Mentors club leadership as Adviser, Rotaract Club of Sukedhara

experience.summary: Lead planning and delivery of national youth-entrepreneurship programs, directing outreach and cultivation with colleges, youth networks, sponsors and government stakeholders.
Coordinated Nepal Business Summit 2025 and Nepal Youth Entrepreneurship Summit 2025 end to end: recruitment, sponsors, media and policymakers.
Overseeing education, sanitation and community-development activities across 18 districts and 29 schools, with stakeholder and donor reporting.
Designing and delivering national training on Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation, MHM and WASH. Trained 5,000+ youth, educators and community members across 10+ districts.

roles.detail: Leads planning and execution of national-level business and entrepreneurship summits.
